title: 0034 회계 한눈에 — 달마다 매출(받은 돈 · 일반과세 공급가) · 매입 · 자산, 계정 미정 · 부가세 모름 · 증빙 경고 수, 계정별 · 지출 상대 상위(다듬은 상호로 묶음), 취소 줄 뺌, 기간 400일까지, 서버만 (scripts/rls-probe.mjs)
setup: INSERT INTO public.companies (id, kind, name, plan, status) VALUES ({{company_x}}, 'partner', 'probe X', 'agent', 'active')
INSERT INTO public.company_members (company_id, user_id, role, status) VALUES ({{company_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, 'owner', 'active'), ({{company_x}}, {{x_staff_user}}, 'staff', 'active')

INSERT INTO public.company_settings (company_id, settings) VALUES ({{company_x}}, '{"tax":{"vat_type":"general","business_kind":"manufacturing"}}'::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (company_id) DO UPDATE SET settings = EXCLUDED.settings
INSERT INTO public.designs (id, user_id, name, company_id) VALUES ({{design_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, 'probe', {{company_x}})
INSERT INTO public.design_snapshots (id, design_id, rev, content_hash, design_payload, bom_payload, item_count) VALUES ({{snap_x}}, {{design_x}}, 1, 'probe', '{}', '{}', 1)

INSERT INTO public.design_documents (id, design_id, snapshot_id, doc_type, rev, doc_no, title, render_payload, content_hash) VALUES ({{doc_x}}, {{design_x}}, {{snap_x}}, 'work_order', 1, 'probe-' || {{doc_x}}::text, 'probe', '{}', 'probe')

INSERT INTO public.orders (id, order_no, design_id, document_id, snapshot_id, contract_amount, company_id, customer_name) VALUES ({{order_x}}, 'probe-' || {{order_x}}::text, {{design_x}}, {{doc_x}}, {{snap_x}}, 0, {{company_x}}, '고객A')
INSERT INTO public.order_payments (order_id, stage, amount, paid_on) VALUES ({{order_x}}, 'deposit', 1100000, '2026-09-10'), ({{order_x}}, 'balance', 2200000, '2026-10-05')

INSERT INTO public.order_costs (order_id, category, amount, vat_amount, evidence_type, vendor_name, spent_on) VALUES ({{order_x}}, 'material', 300000, 30000, 'tax_invoice', '가나목재', '2026-09-12'), ({{order_x}}, 'logistics', 50000, NULL, 'statement', '다라운송', '2026-10-03')

INSERT INTO public.ledger_entries (company_id, entry_date, direction, account, counterparty_name, amount, vat_amount, evidence_type, source, created_by) VALUES ({{company_x}}, '2026-10-20', 'expense', 'admin.supplies', '(주)가나목재', 40000, 0, 'simple_receipt', 'manual', {{x_owner_user}}), ({{company_x}}, '2026-10-21', 'expense', 'purchase.materials', '가나 목재', 500000, 50000, 'card', 'manual', {{x_owner_user}}), ({{company_x}}, '2026-10-22', 'asset_buy', 'asset.tangible', '라마기계', 1000000, 100000, 'card', 'manual', {{x_owner_user}})

INSERT INTO public.ledger_entries (id, company_id, entry_date, direction, account, counterparty_name, amount, evidence_type, source, created_by) VALUES ({{entry_void}}, {{company_x}}, '2026-10-23', 'expense', 'admin.supplies', '취소상호', 999999, 'card', 'manual', {{x_owner_user}})
UPDATE public.ledger_entries SET voided_at = now(), voided_by = {{x_owner_user}}, void_reason = 'probe' WHERE id = {{entry_void}}

checks.name: 서버만 — 9월: 받은 돈 공급가 · 부가세, 매입 · 부가세
10월 — 매입(원가 + 장부 줄) · 자산 따로 · 부가세 모름 원가 1 · 증빙 경고 2 · 취소 줄 뺌
10월 지출 상대 — 자산 포함 · 다듬은 상호로 묶음 · 큰 차례 (고객 이름 · 취소 줄 없음)
checks.sql: select string_agg((e->>'name') || ':' || (e->>'amount'), ',' order by ord) from (select public.ledger_summary({{company_x}}, '2026-09-01', '2026-10-31') s) q, jsonb_array_elements(q.s->'suppliers') with ordinality t(e, ord) where e->>'month' = '2026-10'

checks.name: 계정별 — 원가 종류는 업종 잇기로 계정, 9월 재료비 매입 · 10월 운반비
checks.sql: select string_agg((e->>'month') || ' ' || coalesce(e->>'account', '-') || ' ' || (e->>'amount'), ',' order by ord) from (select public.ledger_summary({{company_x}}, '2026-09-01', '2026-10-31') s) q, jsonb_array_elements(q.s->'accounts') with ordinality t(e, ord)
